services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: With your family and friends you can can relax, listen to music and enjoy a guided tour of the city from the ocean. As the sun begins to set, we will cruise down to either Bedford Basin or the Northwest Arm to Watch a beautiful sunset over the city. After the sun sets we will make our way back to dock or you can request to dropped off at one of HRM’s many public docks where you can continue your evening further into the city. blurb: Guests can experience the Halifax Harbour by the hour or full day excursions including sunset tours, boating and hiking tours, and full day private boat tours. They also offer deep sea fishing tours and transportation services such as round trip ferry service to Birch & Anchor with dining options. The tours provide unique views of Halifax from the water and opportunities for social and corporate events.
